description: Implementation of SHA1 hashing algorithm optimized for word access, including functions for initialization, update, and finalization of SHA1 hash computation.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Init
methods.description: Initializes SHA1 context with standard constants and zero size.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Update
methods.description: Updates SHA1 context with new data, processing in 64-byte blocks.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Final
methods.description: Finalizes SHA1 hash, producing the 20-byte hash output.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Block
methods.description: Processes a 512-bit block of data to update the hash state.
